about: One short card for every new thing (T52), next to the campaign table (campaign.json): what it is, how to use it, and where it is on the island. A row covers campaign ids (every id of campaign.json is covered by exactly one row; tests/tutorial/unlock-cards.test.js fails otherwise), or names its own wave for a thing outside the table (the arsenal, the culverin, gunboats, finishers, tearing down, the extra tower spots of D060). where: an island zone id (a build spot, island_bell, island_harbor, island_techhub, island_wreck, island_arsenal, island_cabin), 'hud:menu' for the Menu button, or null when there is nothing on the island to point at. flag: shown only while that feature flag is on ('!name': only while it is off). menu: where the thing lives in the Menu. practice: the boss finishers' own first-time practice (T28) comes with it. A new campaign id gets its card by adding a row here.

cards.title: Walls, cannons and your musket
cards.what: Walls stop boarders at the shore. Cannons fire at ships on their own.
cards.how: Walk to a glowing spot and press E (or Use). Click toward a ship or press F to fire your musket.

cards.title: Captain upgrades
cards.what: Your captain can grow stronger: more damage and range for your gun.
cards.how: Open Menu › Captain and skills and raise your level with coins.

cards.title: Houses
cards.what: A house adds loot after every wave you win.
cards.how: Walk to a house spot inland and press E to build one for 🪙 50.

cards.title: Tear a building down
cards.what: Built in the wrong place? You can tear a building down between waves.
cards.how: Open its card and choose Tear down. Everyone who paid for it gets half of their coins back.

cards.title: Level 2
cards.what: Walls get more health, cannons hit harder and reach farther.
cards.how: Walk up to a wall or cannon you built, press E and choose Upgrade.

cards.title: The mortar
cards.what: A mortar throws its shell high and hits every ship near where it lands.
cards.how: Walk to an empty tower spot, press E and choose Mortar.

cards.title: House jobs
cards.what: A level-2 house picks a job: Barracks sends out militia, a Tavern heals captains, a Workshop speeds up wall repairs.
cards.how: Raise a house to level 2, open its card and pick a job. You can change it between waves.

cards.title: The arsenal
cards.what: New guns are in the crew's shared weapon rack: pistols first, more after later waves.
cards.how: Walk to the arsenal and press E. Buy a gun, take it, and put it back for a friend.

cards.title: The watchtower
cards.what: The watchtower gives every tower on the island more range.
cards.how: Walk up the hill at the north end of the path and build it on its spot.

cards.title: A gunner for the crew
cards.what: A gunner mans your strongest tower: it reloads 25% faster.
cards.how: Open Menu › Crew and hire one.

cards.title: The Harbor
cards.what: The Harbor on the east beach has a market stall: guess whether a real price goes up or down in 5 minutes.
cards.how: Walk to the Harbor, press E and put 5, 10 or 25 🪙 on your call.

cards.title: Boss finishers
cards.what: Wave 5 brings the first boss warship. When she is almost sunk, every captain plays a short finisher game to bring her down.
cards.how: The first time, you can practice before it counts: choose Practice or Skip practice. Settings › Easier finishers makes it gentler.

cards.title: The inner wall ring
cards.what: Six more wall spots stand around the heart of the island: the last line against boarders.
cards.how: Walk to a wall spot near the middle and build a wall there.

cards.title: A carpenter for the crew
cards.what: A carpenter mends your most damaged wall during a wave.
cards.how: Open Menu › Crew and hire one.

cards.title: Level 3
cards.what: Walls, cannons, mortars and houses can go to level 3.
cards.how: Walk up to a building, press E and choose Upgrade.

cards.title: The wreck
cards.what: A wreck lies on the west beach. Mend her and one day she sails again.
cards.how: Walk to her and press E. Anyone can pay 🪙 25 or 🪙 100 into the repair after a wave.

cards.title: Guards
cards.what: Guards stand by the heart and fight boarders who get that far.
cards.how: Open Menu › Crew and hire up to three.

cards.title: The match board
cards.what: The Harbor has a match board: pick who wins a real football match.
cards.how: Walk to the Harbor, press E and choose the match board.

cards.title: The Tech hub
cards.what: Research a tower kind once, and every tower of that kind can pick a skill.
cards.how: Walk to the Tech hub in the north-east, press E and choose a branch.

cards.title: A lookout for the crew
cards.what: A lookout sees farther in fog: ships show 3 seconds earlier.
cards.how: Open Menu › Crew and hire one.

cards.title: Captain levels 4 and 5
cards.what: Your captain can reach level 5.
cards.how: Open Menu › Captain and skills and raise your level.

cards.title: The swivel-gun nest
cards.what: A small fast gun that sprays pellets at boarders on the island, never at ships.
cards.how: Walk to an empty tower spot, press E and choose the swivel-gun nest.

cards.title: Level 4 for cannons and walls
cards.what: Cannons and walls go to level 4, the watchtower to level 3.
cards.how: Walk up to a building, press E and choose Upgrade.

cards.title: The harpoon tower
cards.what: The harpoon tower throws a rope harpoon that slows one ship at a time.
cards.how: Walk to an empty tower spot, press E and choose Harpoon tower.

cards.title: Raiders
cards.what: Fast red-sailed raiders sail in from now on.
cards.how: Cannons answer them best: keep one on every side of the island.

cards.title: Level 4 for mortars and more
cards.what: Mortars, harpoon towers, swivel-gun nests and the watchtower go to level 4.
cards.how: Walk up to a building, press E and choose Upgrade.

cards.title: Tougher bosses
cards.what: Redtide's boss warships take more hits from now on.
cards.how: Mortars hit them hardest. Raise them before the next boss wave.

cards.title: Tier 2 at the Tech hub
cards.what: Each tower kind can learn a second, stronger skill.
cards.how: Walk to the Tech hub, press E and research tier 2.

cards.title: Gunboats are coming
cards.what: From wave 16 small gunboats stop far out and jam a tower for a few seconds.
cards.how: Mortars and your musket reach them. Sink them fast.

cards.title: The culverin
cards.what: A long gun for a tower spot. It reaches the gunboats and siege barges that shoot your towers from far out.
cards.how: Walk to an empty tower spot, press E and choose Culverin.

cards.title: Level 5
cards.what: Every tower and wall can reach level 5, the highest level.
cards.how: Walk up to a building, press E and choose Upgrade.

cards.title: Brutes
cards.what: Big brutes come ashore. They hack walls faster.
cards.how: Keep your walls mended and your captains near the shore.

cards.title: Tower upgrade trees
cards.what: A level-5 tower grows on in a small tree: one path fires faster, the other hits harder.
cards.how: Open a level-5 tower's card and buy tier 1 of a path.

cards.title: Tier 3 at the Tech hub
cards.what: Pick one of two big skills for each tower kind.
cards.how: Walk to the Tech hub, press E and research tier 3.

cards.title: Ironclads
cards.what: Iron-plated brigs join the fleet, and every ship grows tougher fast.
cards.how: Use research, tower trees and the whole crew from here on.

cards.title: Your own ship
cards.what: The repaired wreck sails. Between waves, play her short games for extra coins.
cards.how: Walk to her on the west beach, press E and pick a game.

cards.title: Tier 2 of the tower trees
cards.what: A level-5 tower can take the second tier of one path.
cards.how: Open its card and buy tier 2.

cards.title: Tier 3 of the tower trees
cards.what: The top of a tower's tree. One path goes to the top; the other stays at tier 1.
cards.how: Open its card and buy tier 3.

cards.title: Dreadnoughts
cards.what: Redtide sends his dreadnoughts. No tower holds them alone.
cards.how: Bring the whole crew, every captain at a post.

cards.title: New tower spot!
cards.what: One more tower spot opened south-west of your cabin. Any tower can stand there.
cards.how: Walk to it, press E and choose a tower.

cards.title: New tower spot!
cards.what: One more tower spot opened in the north-east, by the Tech hub. Any tower can stand there.
cards.how: Walk to it, press E and choose a tower.

cards.title: New tower spot!
cards.what: One more tower spot opened south of the heart, by the bench. Any tower can stand there.
cards.how: Walk to it, press E and choose a tower.

cards.title: New tower spot!
cards.what: One more tower spot opened by the main path, north-west of the heart. Any tower can stand there.
cards.how: Walk to it, press E and choose a tower.

cards.title: The final battle
cards.what: Wave 100 brings Captain Redtide himself.
cards.how: Get everything to its highest level, then ring the bell.
